title: M3-3 DvP research, phases 0-1: continuity, v0 reproduction, completed-game pipeline and projection firewall
objective: Continue slice M3-3 under the owner's DvP research specification (docs/research/Arbit_FFA_M3_DvP_Plan.md v1.1, OWN-074). Phase 0: inventory and freeze the v0 odd/even study (scripts/model/defense_position_study.py and its 2026-11-23 receipt) without changing it, map every source it read, audit its lineage for provider fantasy projections, reproduce its r, k and weights exactly from the pinned FFA targets, and disposition every discrepancy. Phase 1: a projection-free, completed-game DvP observation pipeline over the canonical FFA actuals (team-game-position sums, defense inversion, D/ST offense orientation, true zero versus missing, schedule reconciliation to 5,278 team-games, relocation and refusal audits), a lineage allowlist that fails closed, a completed-game as-of index with preweek and per-game cutoffs, and tests T01-T07 and T29-T40 executed. Offline and read-only: no canonical scoring table, feature weight, service or deployment changes.

review.summary: Read before design: the owner's DvP specification v1.1 in full (sections 0-14); v0 study scripts/model/defense_position_study.py (method: REG, basis statistics athlete lines summed per team-game-position with zero fill, defense inversion, same-season leave-one-out offense adjustment, D/ST keyed by the offense, odd/even NFL weeks with >=4 games per half via ffa_signal_study.split_half, k = m(1-r)/r with m the mean half size) and its receipt (320 defense-seasons per position, 315 for D/ST, 5,278 team-games); ffa_signal_study.split_half and pearson; the canonical targets store data/model (index 4afbd836..., built 2026-11-10 from code de72924+uncommitted, rules athlete 10e938eb / defense 16885a80, per-season manifests with pinned nflverse manifest inputs, refusal counts) and its slice 2 check receipt ffa-targets-check-2026-11-10.json (10,734 of 10,771 lines equal ESPN actual applied totals; index 994b3018 differs from the current pointer); build_targets.py, targets.py (D/ST loop skips a game when either team's stats_team row is missing), arbit_model.inputs.NflverseTables (pinned manifests come from the database), gamebook POSITIONS/FFA_POSITIONS, league_policy lineup slots, timing.STATISTICS (day after the game, 12:00 UTC, retrospective rule), fields.py policy exclusions (generic fantasy_points, ffopportunity, DynastyProcess/FantasyPros, ESPN draft projections; OWN-061), ESPN stat-source handling (actual blocks statSourceId 0 only). Found while reviewing: D/ST targets lack the Raiders 2016-2019 and Chargers 2016 and every D/ST facing them (schedule codes OAK/SD vs team stats LV/LAC; 156 REG team-games); refused athlete lines have null points that v0 summed as zero; Gamebooks (3b) include postseason games in last-season features.

plan.summary: Phase 0-1 of the owner's DvP spec, offline and read-only. (1) arbit_model.dvp.provenance: source allowlist keyed by source id with full known schema per source; admit() fails closed on unknown source, forbidden source type, missing ancestry, scoring-hash mismatch or any unknown column (so a renamed projection like opponent_expected cannot pass); exclusion audit records. (2) arbit_model.dvp.observations: completed REG games from the pinned schedule with franchise codes (OAK->LV, SD->LAC), two team-games per completed game, opponent taken from the schedule rather than the targets row, team-game-position sums of canonical FFA actuals (FB->RB; true zero only for a covered team-game; a refused line makes the cell invalid, never zero), defense inversion, D/ST as points conceded by the offense with missing lines kept missing, availability time by the statistics rule (day after the game, 12:00 UTC, retrospective), and a reconciliation report. (3) arbit_model.dvp.asof: preweek and per-game cutoffs, eligible-features view versus labels-after view, frozen-forecast evaluation join, league prior from eligible actuals only. (4) arbit_model.dvp.reliability: v0 split-half (odd/even NFL weeks, >=4 per half), k = m(1-r)/r with unidentified r<=0, w(n), unequal-half expected r, Pearson/Spearman, Fisher and seeded bootstrap intervals. (5) arbit_model.dvp.results: experiment record with forbidden_vendor_projection_dependencies that invalidates any nonzero result. (6) scripts/model/dvp.py audit and reproduce-v0 with config/dvp/base.json: rerun v0's own script on the pinned index and diff with its receipt, independent recompute, k-formula check, a v0-validated variant on the validated observations, receipts under docs/research/dvp and bulky outputs under artifacts/dvp/<run_id>. (7) Tests T01-T07 and T29-T40 on fixtures. v0 files stay byte-identical; the canonical D/ST gap is reported, not repaired here.

implementation.summary: arbit_model.dvp (provenance, observations, asof, reliability, results), scripts/model/dvp.py (audit, reproduce-v0, registry) and config/dvp/base.json. Provenance admits sources by allowlist with full known schemas (targets by adapter schema, nflverse by the field catalog), scoring-hash and row-value checks, and fails closed on anything unknown; a code scan looks for provider projection tokens and ESPN/Sleeper reader imports. Observations take the opponent from the schedule with franchise codes, keep refused, duplicate and uncovered cells missing, put D/ST on the offense, and stamp row lineage and availability. Asof separates feature views from labels with a frozen-forecast join and an actuals-only prior. Reliability ports v0's split-half and adds unequal-half, Fisher and seeded bootstrap tools. Results enforce forbidden_vendor_projection_dependencies. Tests T01-T13, T21-T22, T29-T40 (38) in five test_dvp files. Bug found and fixed during implementation: the first audit compared the target row's raw opponent column because it survived the schedule join; dropping it before the join leaves exactly the 1,327 self-attributed Raiders/Chargers home rows.
